description.narrative: (Ethiopia): Resilience in Pastoral Areas North (RiPA North) improves the resilience capacities of households, markets, and local institutions across 22 target districts in the Somali, Afar, and Oromia regions of Ethiopia. The activity contributes to enhanced food security and inclusive economic growth for over 178,000 households. FY 2022 funds will continue to strengthen disaster risk management systems and capabilities of communities and local governments through training, technical advice, and institutional support. The activity will facilitate two-way early warning and response information flow between communities and local governments at regional, district, and community-levels. The activity will also catalyze inclusive and effective labor markets and a dynamic private sector to improve economic and employment opportunities for youth and women. The activity increases productivity and marketing of livestock and crop systems by strengthening rangeland management and improving access to animal health service, water supply, farm inputs, and financial services...RiPA North will continue to promote nutrition-sensitive and nutrition-smart agricultural practices. It will provide social behavior change communication interventions to tackle the multi-dimensional nutrition, sanitation, and hygiene problems that affect health and economic growth of target households. It will promote increased consumption of animal source foods. The activity will also continue to co-lead and facilitate the Ethiopian Civil Society Coalition for Scaling-up Nutrition to strengthen the strategic partnership with other resilience focused programs to scale up nutrition and WASH best practices in target pastoral areas....
